name: plan
summary: per-project plan store: issues, features, fleet, sections

name: publish
summary: push a plan's GitHub structure — repos, board, one issue per plan row

name: errors
summary: per-project runtime-fault store: fingerprinted errors + alerts

name: usage
summary: per-project usage-events store: record + query what users do (epic #3809)

name: project
summary: cross-project hub: list local projects + the .published marker
store: the project hub list + the .published marker

name: skill
summary: global skills + task-groups store

name: compliance
summary: compliance standards corpus

name: atlas
summary: product feature inventories: domains · products · capabilities (relational)

name: blueprint
summary: user blueprint store

name: fin
summary: personal finance: statement ingest + position. LOCAL — reads the files you name and sends nothing anywhere

name: radio
summary: the AIR as one noun: `radio rf` (LIVE capture off a wireless radio) · `radio bt` (OFFLINE analysis of a Bluetooth capture you supply). Both DEFENSIVE and PASSIVE — neither ever transmits

name: rf
summary: DEPRECATED → use `bsc radio rf`. DEFENSIVE RF monitoring: detect radio jamming from the radio's own telemetry. Read-only — it observes a medium it never transmits on

name: bluetooth
summary: DEPRECATED → use `bsc radio bt`. DEFENSIVE Bluetooth analysis: catch SPOOFING (address-twin · rssi/interval/service deviation from a learned baseline) and malicious signals (rogue scan · unwanted tracker) from the advertising plane, passively

name: persona
summary: user persona store: agent identities (prompt + skills + model over a role)

name: sound
summary: user sound-kit store: synthesized cues (primitives + voices + cues)

name: teams
summary: user teams store: persona-relationship graph (positions + relationships)
store: orgs/ — user; the on-disk dir keeps its pre-rename name

name: network
summary: user network store: a DOMAIN owning a set of projects and one architect session
store: networks/ — user; membership is the `network` column on the project row

name: secret
summary: credential store: which services we are paired with and whether those pairings still work (metadata + derived status; NO verb reads a secret back)
store: secrets.db — user; the VALUE lives in the OS keychain, not here

name: studio
summary: Studio store: shareable snapshots of the app's library state (save · apply · list · get · remove)

name: org
summary: DEPRECATED (#2700) → use `bsc teams` (the store, renamed org → teams)
store: orgs/ — the same store `bsc teams` serves

name: component
summary: DEPRECATED (#2469) → use `bsc components` (the component verbs now live there)
store: the component library — the same store `bsc components` serves

name: ui
summary: UI design surface: the primitive contract + themes (#1852) + the component library (#2469) + the released-kit store (release, #2465)
store: the component library + themes + released kits — graph/components.db committed

name: logs
summary: unified logs + perf + cost (read-only) + `logs scope` runtime console-scope control
store: the unified log / perf / cost engine

name: files
summary: read-only file toolkit: tree (folder structure) · stat · read · refs

name: shot
summary: capture the RUNNING app's real pixels — a webview snapshot (needs the app running)

name: navigate
summary: steer the RUNNING app to a view — so a capture can target something

name: fleet
summary: which fleet panes are ACTUALLY alive — real liveness + pid from the running app

name: sandbox
summary: a caged session's rendered launch argv: inspect or replay it outside the app (#135)
store: the pane's sandbox-stores dir — per-session, cleared with the pane

name: session
summary: a session, both halves: MANAGE the app-owned system ones (start · stop · list) and INSPECT what any session gets (perms · skills · mcp · argv)

name: metrics
summary: fleet-wide generation scoreboard — $ / tokens / cache-hit / wall-clock per project
store: the unified log / perf / cost engine

name: perf
summary: the FRONTEND instrumentation — render commits, named phases, jank windows, bsc spawns (read-only)

name: cost
summary: the RESOURCE-COST surface — build wall-clock, build memory, the app's JS heap / DOM / listeners, a session's RSS slope (read-only)
store: the project run store + the browser harness

name: mem
summary: DEPRECATED → use `bsc cost` (the resource-cost surface, renamed so `bsc memory` can be the session-memory surface)
store: the project run store + the browser harness

name: memory
summary: session memory: capture findings, decisions, lessons and parked threads — tagged and linkable, so what a session learns is traversable, not lost

name: imprint
summary: how the user WRITES — a read-only style profile (casing, apostrophes, habitual misspellings, emoticon vocabulary). The written half of the imprint `bsc ear` builds for the voice. It DECIDES NOTHING: no verdict, no score, and no record of any comparison

name: work
summary: the work loop: run the gate and RECORD what it actually did on the change record
store: the per-project plan store — the change record's gate evidence + the known-red declarations

name: self
summary: this binary and its siblings: is the `bsc` you are about to run trustworthy, and which one would be used

name: resolve
summary: what a session RECEIVES: its resolved skills and MCP servers (read-only)

name: disk
summary: reclaim build-tree disk: gc, prune, sweep, and dedupe across worktrees

name: worktree
summary: the worktree pool: list every tree, cap the parked/merged ones (DESTRUCTIVE)

name: debug
summary: inspect the RUNNING app's live DOM + preview state (read-only)

name: llm
summary: the LOCAL model runtime: what slot count and context ollama actually GRANTED, vs what was asked

name: loop
summary: conversation loop store: two participants exchange turns until a signal ends it, or never (#3262)

name: request
summary: improvement-request store: the designer→debug channel for bsc components surface gaps (#3295)

name: runtime
summary: runtime attestations: which RECORD actually served each module while the app ran

name: graph
summary: algorithms knowledge library: per-language implementations (impl list · dump · harvest · curate)
store: the record ledger — graph/algorithms.db committed, knowledge/graph.db runtime, $BSC_GRAPH_STORE

name: cad
summary: mesh/SDF geometry kernel (mm): mesh an op-tree spec into a binary STL

name: widget
summary: toggleable UI surfaces: one NODE per widget and the stream it subscribes to
store: a closed set in code — an id selects a node, never a path

name: ear
summary: always-on local capture: speech-only segments inside an enforced retention window (the listening half of `say`)

name: imagine
summary: what the ear hears, as pictures: one entry per thought, bounded and local

name: say
summary: speak text aloud: kokoro (neural, phoneme-level) when installed, then piper, then the OS voice (NOT `sound`, which is the synthesis kit store)
store: no store — voices in ~/.base-studio-code/voices and models/kokoro

name: lan
summary: the emit-only LAN sensor: what a host exposes · its keys · what it would send (NOT `network`, which is the user domain store)
store: no store yet — keys are printed, never written

name: deploy
summary: ship a binary to a device and take it back: status · push · rollback (push-only; LAB has no egress)

name: capability
summary: the USE layer: what a network can DO right now, and how fresh each answer is

name: data
summary: canonical data model (DuckDB): model · scan · tables · connector

name: security
summary: the security surface: scan a repo for vulnerable dependencies AND leaked credentials (tree + git history), as one ranked finding list

name: cve
summary: → `bsc security deps`. The vulnerability half of the security surface; kept because its exit-code contract gates CI and the install hook

name: news
summary: low-trust news layer: poll outlets · brief an event (corroboration · framing · agency deletion). NOT `research` — an article is a claim, a paper is a source
store: the news store — every fetched article version, $BSC_NEWS_DB

name: survival
summary: the caveman network's OFFLINE survival corpus: procedures ranked by the materials in your hands · natural remedies by function and location · compile the lot into one field manual

name: surface
summary: THIS catalog: every bsc command surface as data (list · --json) — one source for help, the node set and drift checks
store: the command-surface catalog, compiled into this binary

name: mcp
summary: MCP: the server store (`server`) + the bundled stdio servers (research/compliance/cve)

name: hook
summary: internal PreToolUse deny hooks (run by Claude Code, not by hand)

name: serve
summary: internal WARM server (#4152) — one long-lived process answering many requests; the desktop spawns it

name: version
summary: which build this binary IS — its build time + path (#92, tells a stale sidecar from a missing verb)

name: config
summary: runtime config-seed mirror: classify a diverged file against the packaged seed, with a diff, and adopt it (#168)

name: github
summary: GitHub rules a session can ask about: issue provenance, REST path routing, board shape (read-only)
store: no store - derived rules over a GitHub payload; it never reads a credential back

name: perms
summary: what a session role actually resolves to: capability, denies, tool rules, write scope (read-only)
store: the frozen role-capability baseline + the packaged permission data

name: app
summary: the APP's own lifecycle: status, promote (develop -> main at the root), rebuild, release, hooks
store: the repo root's git refs + the built app binary
